papers.abstract: As the burgeoning power requirements of sophisticated neural architectures escalate, the information retrieval community has recognized ecological sustainability as a pivotal priority that necessitates a fundamental paradigm shift in model design. While contemporary neural rankers have attained unprecedented accuracy, the substantial environmental externalities associated with their computational intensity often remain overlooked in large-scale deployments. We present GaiaFlow, an innovative framework engineered to facilitate carbon-frugal search by operationalizing semantic-guided diffusion tuning. Our methodology orchestrates the convergence of retrieval-guided Langevin dynamics and a hardware-independent performance modeling strategy to optimize the trade-off between search precision and environmental preservation. By incorporating adaptive early exit protocols and precision-aware quantized inference, the proposed architecture significantly mitigates operational carbon footprints while maintaining robust retrieval quality across heterogeneous computing infrastructures. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that GaiaFlow achieves a superior equilibrium between effectiveness and energy efficiency, offering a scalable and sustainable pathway for next-generation neural search systems.

analysis.key_results: 在实验评估中实现效果与能效的卓越平衡，提供可扩展的可持续神经搜索路径。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GaiaFlow框架，结合检索引导朗之万动力学与硬件无关的性能建模，以及自适应早退和精度感知量化推理，优化搜索精度与环保的权衡。
analysis.method: 语义引导扩散调优，融合检索引导朗之万动力学、硬件无关性能建模、自适应早退协议和精度感知量化推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出GaiaFlow框架，通过语义引导扩散调优、自适应早退和精度感知量化推理，在维持检索质量的同时大幅降低碳足迹。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于神经搜索系统的量化与高效推理，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving augments end-to-end (E2E) planning with language-enabled visual backbones, yet it remains unclear how vision-language models (VLMs) differ from standard vision-only encoders and whether these differences survive policy learning. We study this question under a unified VLM-hidden + diffusion-policy paradigm, comparing multiple VLM families/scales (e.g., InternVL3 and Qwen3VL) with vision-only encoders (e.g., ResNet, ViT, and EVA-CLIP). We ask three questions: how similar are their representations, do residual differences induce meaningful behavioral differences, and how can they improve accuracy-cost trade-offs? We find that VLM and vision-only policies share a substantial common subspace after policy learning, yet both retain non-transferable residual subspaces. Using a Shared-Unique SAE, we show that these residual factors are behaviorally relevant: vision-only encoders are stronger in simple, geometry-dominant scenarios, whereas VLMs are stronger in long-tail, semantically complex, and interaction-heavy cases. The two policy families also exhibit distinct driving styles, with vision-only models being more conservative on average and VLMs more assertive. Exploiting the complementarity between a VLM branch and a ViT branch yields an oracle upper bound of 93.58 PDMS on NAVSIM. We introduce HybridDriveVLA, which runs both branches and uses a learned trajectory scorer for selection, improving PDMS to 92.10 (+1.30 over the VLM baseline), and DualDriveVLA, a fast-slow variant that invokes the VLM in only 15% of scenarios, achieving 91.00 PDMS (+0.20) with about a 1.9x latency speedup over the VLM baseline. Code will be released.

analysis.key_results: HybridDriveVLA PDMS 92.10（+1.30 over VLM baseline），DualDriveVLA PDMS 91.00（+0.20）且延迟约1.9倍加速；Oracle上限93.58 PDMS。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示了VLM与纯视觉编码器在策略学习后存在共享与独有子空间，并基于互补性提出HybridDriveVLA和DualDriveVLA快慢系统，在NAVSIM上取得PDMS 92.10和91.00，后者在仅15%场景调用VLM的情况下实现约1.9倍加速。
analysis.method: 采用统一VLM-隐式+扩散策略范式，比较InternVL3、Qwen3VL等VLM与ResNet、ViT、EVA-CLIP等纯视觉编码器；使用Shared-Unique SAE分析表征差异；提出双分支混合/快慢选择框架。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作探索了VLA驾驶策略中VLM与纯视觉编码器的表征差异与互补性，并提出快慢双系统架构以提升精度-延迟权衡。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 核心聚焦VLA驾驶策略，通过分析VLM与纯视觉主干在规划中的互补性并设计高效双系统架构，直接推动VLA模型的准确率与推理效率。

papers.abstract: In this work, we present AfriNLLB, a series of lightweight models for efficient translation from and into African languages. AfriNLLB supports 15 language pairs (30 translation directions), including Swahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Amharic, Somali, Zulu, Lingala, Afrikaans, Wolof, and Egyptian Arabic, as well as other African Union official languages such as Arabic (MSA), French, Portuguese, and Spanish. Our training data covers bidirectional translation between English and 13 languages, and between French and two languages (Lingala and Wolof). AfriNLLB models are based on NLLB-200 600M, which we compress using iterative layer pruning and quantization. We fine-tune the pruned models on parallel corpora we curated for African languages, employing knowledge distillation from a larger teacher model. Our work aims at enabling efficient deployment of translation models for African languages in resource-constrained settings. Our evaluation results demonstrate that AfriNLLB models achieve performance comparable to the baseline while being significantly faster. We release two versions of the AfriNLLB models, a Transformers version that allows further fine-tuning and a CTranslate2 version for efficient inference. Moreover, we release all the training data that we used for fine-tuning the baseline and pruned models to facilitate further research.

analysis.key_results: AfriNLLB模型在性能上与基线相当，但推理速度显著更快。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AfriNLLB系列轻量模型，通过层剪枝和量化压缩NLLB-200，并针对非洲语言进行微调和知识蒸馏，实现高效翻译。
analysis.method: 基于NLLB-200 600M，使用迭代层剪枝和量化进行压缩；在整理的多语言平行语料上微调剪枝模型，并结合教师模型的知识蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AfriNLLB系列轻量模型，通过迭代层剪枝和量化压缩NLLB-200，微调后用于非洲语言双向翻译，实现高效推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于非洲语言的高效翻译模型，其核心是模型压缩（剪枝与量化）技术，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人相关主题，无直接关系。但其采用的模型压缩与高效推理方法对本站关注的VLA/WAM高效部署具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently gained significant attention due to their inherent support for parallel decoding. Building on this paradigm, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs with autoregressive (AR) initialization have further demonstrated strong performance competitive with mainstream AR models. However, we identify a fundamental mismatch between MoE architectures and diffusion-based decoding. Specifically, a large number of experts are activated at each denoising step, while only a small subset of tokens is ultimately accepted, resulting in substantial inference overhead and limiting their deployment in latency-sensitive applications. In this work, we propose TEAM, a plug-and-play framework that accelerates MoE dLLMs by enabling more accepted tokens with fewer activated experts. TEAM is motivated by the observation that expert routing decisions exhibit strong temporal consistency across denoising levels as well as spatial consistency across token positions. Leveraging these properties, TEAM employs three complementary expert activation and decoding strategies, conservatively selecting necessary experts for decoded and masked tokens and simultaneously performing aggressive speculative exploration across multiple candidates. Experimental results demonstrate that TEAM achieves up to 2.2x speedup over vanilla MoE dLLM, with negligible performance degradation. Code is released at https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/TEAM-MoE-dLLM.

analysis.key_results: 在MoE扩散语言模型上实现最高2.2倍加速，且性能下降可忽略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的加速框架TEAM，在MoE扩散语言模型中通过时空一致性引导专家激活和投机探索，显著降低推理开销。
analysis.method: 基于观察到的专家路由在去噪层级间的时序一致性和跨token的空间一致性，TEAM采用三种互补的专家激活与解码策略：保守选择已解码和掩码token的必要专家，同时对多个候选进行激进投机探索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TEAM框架，通过利用专家路由在去噪步间的时序一致性和token位置间的空间一致性，减少MoE扩散语言模型中激活的专家数量并提升被接受token数，实现加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于文本领域MoE扩散语言模型的推测解码加速，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人任务。其方法可能对使用MoE架构的高效机器人模型有潜在参考价值，但目前无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Achieving reliable 4-bit attention is a prerequisite for end-to-end FP4 computation on emerging FP4-capable GPUs, yet attention remains the main obstacle due to FP4's tiny dynamic range and attention's heavy-tailed activations. This paper presents the first systematic study of 4-bit quantization-aware training (QAT) for attention. We find ``drop-in'' QAT -- naively combining an FP4 forward pass with high-precision Flash Attention (FA)-style backward pass -- leads to training instability. We identify two key principles for stable FP4 attention: (1) matching low-precision recomputation of attention scores in the backward pass and (2) resolving implicit precision assumptions in FA's gradient calculation. Based on these insights, we propose Attn-QAT and implement fused Triton kernels for training and FP4 inference kernels. Across diffusion and language models, Attn-QAT recovers the quality drop from FP4 attention without explicit outlier-mitigation heuristics used in prior FP4 attention, and delivers up to a 1.5x speedup on an RTX 5090 over SageAttention3 and up to a 1.74x speedup over FA4 on a GB300. Video demos can be found at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/190F6xbBDUF2kGQYIcXBt3ehSYij5jlim?usp=sharing. Code can be found at https://haoailab.com/FastVideo/training/attn_qat/.

analysis.key_results: 在扩散和语言模型上恢复FP4注意力造成的质量损失，并在RTX 5090上相比SageAttention3实现1.5倍加速，在GB300上相比FA4实现1.74倍加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次系统研究4比特量化感知训练在注意力上的应用，提出解决训练不稳定性的两项原则和Attn-QAT方法。
analysis.method: 提出Attn-QAT，并实现融合Triton内核用于训练和FP4推理，通过匹配反向传播的低精度注意力分数重计算和解决FlashAttention梯度中的隐式精度假设来保证稳定训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文首次系统研究注意力的4比特量化感知训练，通过匹配反向传播的低精度重计算和解析梯度计算中的隐式精度假设，提出Attn-QAT方法，在扩散和语言模型上恢复精度并实现加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于注意力机制的4比特量化训练和推理加速，未提及VLA、WAM或机器人策略模型，因此与本站主题无直接关系。

Our proposed method, Attn-QAT, recovers the quality drop by using quantization-aware training. Note that temporal inconsistency is hard to visualize in sampled frames. We attach video samples in Appendix A without cherry-picking to better showcase the superior quality of Attn-QAT.

papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, but their solutions are often verbose and computationally expensive, and taxing for users to read. In contrast, small language models (SLMs) produce concise outputs with lower inference costs, yet they frequently struggle on challenging multi-step reasoning tasks. Existing inference-time collaboration methods attempt to bridge this gap through imitation, encouraging SLMs to follow the reasoning process of LRMs. However, the student often inherits the mentor's overthinking, producing long and reflective reasoning chains while still falling short in accuracy. We propose MentorCollab, a collaboration method based on mentorship: the SLM remains the primary generator and consults the LRM only when additional reasoning support is needed. At sparsely sampled token positions, we probe for divergence between the two models and use a lightweight verifier to decide whether the SLM should follow a short lookahead segment from its mentor or continue on its own. Across 15 SLM-LRM pairs and 3 domains, our method achieves an average gain of 3.0%, with improvements of up to 8.0% in 12 settings. The resulting traces remain shorter than the mentor's, using only a small fraction of its tokens. These results demonstrate that selective, verified mentorship can boost reasoning accuracy while preserving concise generation.

analysis.key_results: 在15组小模型-大模型配对和3个领域上，平均提升3.0%，其中12种设置下最高提升8.0%，且生成轨迹比大模型更短，仅使用少量大模型token。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种名为 MentorCollab 的推理时协作方法，小模型作为主要生成者，仅在需要时向大模型查询短前瞻片段，并通过轻量验证器决定是否采纳，从而在提升推理准确率的同时避免冗长输出。
analysis.method: MentorCollab：小模型主导生成，在稀疏采样位置探测两模型分歧，利用轻量验证器决定是否跟随大模型的短前瞻片段。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 MentorCollab，通过小模型主导生成并在稀疏位置借助大模型短片段验证与指导，在提升推理准确率的同时保持输出简洁。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的推理效率与简洁生成，不涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人领域，无直接关系。

Under MentorCollab , the mentor proposes short segments, and the generator verifies rather than heuristically accepts them, achieving correct and concise solutions.

papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by producing long chains of thought, but their inference costs are high and often generate redundant reasoning. Small language models (SLMs) are far more efficient, yet struggle on multi-step reasoning tasks. A natural idea is to let a large model guide a small one at inference time as a mentor, yet existing collaboration methods often promote imitation, resulting in verbose reasoning without consistent error correction. We propose MentorCollab, an inference-time collaboration method in which an LRM selectively and sparsely guides an SLM, rather than taking over generation. At randomly sampled token positions, we probe for divergences between the two models and use a lightweight verifier to decide whether the SLM should follow a short lookahead segment from its mentor or continue on its own. Across 15 SLM--LRM pairs and 3 domains (math reasoning, general knowledge, and commonsense reasoning), our method improves performance in 12 settings, with average gains of 3.0% and up to 8.0%, while adopting only having 18.4% tokens generated by the expensive mentor model on average. We find that short segments and selective probing are sufficient for effective collaboration. Our results show that selective inference-time guidance restores large-model reasoning ability without substantial inference overhead.

analysis.key_results: 在15组模型对和3个领域中，12个设置取得提升，平均提升3.0%，最高8.0%，大模型生成token占比仅18.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 一种名为MentorCollab的推理时协作方法，通过稀疏探测和短前瞻段落，让大模型选择性引导小模型，平衡推理性能与代价。
analysis.method: 在随机采样位置探测两模型分歧，用轻量验证器决定小模型是否遵循大模型生成的短前瞻段落，其余位置由小模型独立生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种推理时大模型选择性引导小模型的方法，在数学、常识等推理任务中以少量额外开销提升小模型性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA/WAM无直接关系，属于独立的高效推理/投机解码方法研究，但其通过大模型引导小模型进行高效推理的思想，若将来应用于具身智能模型（如VLA推理加速）可能具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Robots are finding wider adoption in human environments, increasing the need for natural human-robot interaction. However, understanding a natural language command requires the robot to infer the intended task and how to decompose it into executable actions, and to ground those actions in the robot's knowledge of the environment, including relevant objects, agents, and locations. This challenge can be addressed by combining the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to understand natural language with 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) for grounding inferred actions in a semantic representation of the environment. However, many 3DSGs lack explicit spatial relations between objects, even though humans often rely on these relations to describe an environment. This paper investigates whether incorporating open- or closed-vocabulary spatial relations into 3DSGs can improve the ability of LLMs to interpret natural language commands. To address this, we implement two pipelines using off-the-shelf models: an LLM-based pipeline for target object grounding from open-vocabulary language commands and a vision language model-based pipeline to add open-vocabulary spatial edges to 3DSGs from images captured while mapping. Finally, we evaluate two LLMs across 14 scenes using 905 natural language statements (786 procedurally-generated, 119 human-authored) to assess performance on the downstream task of target object grounding. Our study demonstrates that explicit spatial relations improve the ability of LLMs to ground objects, and while open-vocabulary relation generation with vision language models proves feasible from robot-captured images, our analysis did not yield evidence favoring either open- or closed-vocabulary relations.

analysis.key_results: 显式空间关系提升了LLM的物体定位能力；VLM生成开放式词汇关系可行，但未发现其与闭式词汇关系存在显著性能差异。
analysis.main_contribution: 分析显式空间关系在3D场景图中对LLM执行目标物体定位任务的影响，并实现基于LLM和VLM的两条流水线来生成和利用开/闭词汇空间关系。
analysis.method: 使用现成模型实现两条流水线：LLM流水线从开放式语言命令中定位目标物体，VLM流水线从机器人捕获的图像中向3DSG添加开放式词汇空间边。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究将空间关系显式融入3D场景图对LLM基于自然语言命令进行目标物体定位的提升效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文研究语言命令的视觉-语言-动作利用3D场景图进行物体定位，与VLA中语言理解和场景表示直接相关，但未涉及动作生成或世界模型。
